chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbaat and Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, all together, from al-Hakam ibn Miskeen, from Jameel ibn Darraj, who said, 'I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:'
When the slave marries the free woman, his children are free, and when the free man marries the slave woman, his children are (also) free.
ai.seo_question: What is the status of children when one parent is a slave and the other is free?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'freedom of the mother' (or rather, the child's freedom based on the free parent) in mixed-status unions, ensuring that the child inherits the higher status of the free parent. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is foundational for determining the lineage and social standing of offspring in early Islamic society, distinguishing it from other legal schools that may emphasize the mother's status exclusively. It reflects the Prophet's (peace be upon him) and Imam al-Sadiq's (peace be upon him) emphasis on social mobility and the abolition of hereditary slavery for the next generation.
